<<Mending Of Fishing Nets, Briefly>>  

The community is encouraged to participate in the mending of fishing nets as part of our collective effort to preserve marine resources and support sustainable fishing practices. Each week, a designated area is set up where residents can bring damaged nets for repair. This not only helps in recovering valuable fishing materials but also reduces the environmental impact of discarded nets. The mending process is done by trained volunteers and local fishermen, ensuring that the nets are repaired efficiently and safely. By working together, we can ensure that our fishing practices remain sustainable and that the ocean continues to support our livelihoods.
